result.instructions: Tools for Rev.ai, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rev.ai data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run revai_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run revai_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run revai_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. revai_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: revai_get_account
tools.title: Get account and balance
tools.description: The Rev.ai account behind the token: email, free, purchased, total and invoiced balance (USD) and whether HIPAA is on. GET /account.

tools.name: revai_list_jobs
tools.title: List transcription jobs
tools.description: List transcription jobs from the last 30 days, newest first: id, status (in_progress, transcribed, failed), name, duration, language, failure reason. Page with starting_after = the previous reply's next_starting_after. GET /jobs.

starting_after.description: Return jobs older than this job id (exclusive), from next_starting_after.

tools.name: revai_get_job
tools.title: Get job status
tools.description: One transcription job by id: status (in_progress, transcribed, failed), timestamps, duration, language, failure reason. Poll this until status is transcribed. GET /jobs/{id}.

job_id.description: Rev.ai job id (the `id` from revai_submit_job or revai_list_jobs).

tools.name: revai_submit_job
tools.title: Submit transcription job
tools.description: WRITE: start an asynchronous machine transcription job for an audio or video file at a public URL. It uses Rev.ai credit (free credit first). Returns the job with status in_progress; then poll revai_get_job and read the result with revai_get_transcript. Human transcription is not offered. POST /jobs.

media_url.description: Direct download URL of the audio or video file. Rev.ai fetches it; it must be reachable without login.

language.description: Spoken language as an ISO 639-1 code (en, en-us, en-gb, es, fr, de, ...). Default en.

metadata.description: A note stored with the job and returned with it (for example your own reference).

verbatim.description: Keep every false start and disfluency (default true for machine jobs).

speakers_count.description: Number of speakers, if known (English, Spanish, French); improves speaker labels.

speaker_channels_count.description: Number of audio channels with one speaker each. Billed per channel.

forced_alignment.description: More accurate per-word timestamps (en, fr, it, de, es).

summarization_type.description: Also create a summary, read later with revai_get_summary.

delete_after_seconds.description: Delete the job and its data this many seconds after it completes.

tools.name: revai_delete_job
tools.title: Delete job
tools.description: WRITE: permanently delete a finished (transcribed or failed) job with its media and transcript. This cannot be undone. A job still in progress cannot be deleted. DELETE /jobs/{id}.

job_id.description: Rev.ai job id (the `id` from revai_submit_job or revai_list_jobs).

tools.name: revai_get_transcript
tools.title: Get transcript
tools.description: The transcript of a transcribed job. format=text (default) is plain text with speaker labels and timestamps; format=segments is a list of {speaker, start, end, text} per speaker turn (seconds). Long transcripts are paged: repeat with next_offset until it is null. GET /jobs/{id}/transcript.

job_id.description: Rev.ai job id (the `id` from revai_submit_job or revai_list_jobs).

offset.description: text: character position; segments: segment index. Use the previous reply's next_offset (default 0).

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in one reply, 1000-20000 (default 15000).

group_channels_by.description: Multichannel jobs only: how to group words into turns.

tools.name: revai_get_summary
tools.title: Get transcript summary
tools.description: The summary of a transcribed job. It exists only if the job was submitted with summarization_type. Paged by character like revai_get_transcript. GET /jobs/{id}/transcript/summary.

job_id.description: Rev.ai job id (the `id` from revai_submit_job or revai_list_jobs).

offset.description: Start position from the previous reply's next_offset (default 0).

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in one reply, 1000-20000 (default 15000).

tools.name: revai_get_captions
tools.title: Get captions
tools.description: Captions for a transcribed job as SRT (default) or WebVTT. Long files are paged by character: repeat with next_offset until it is null. For multichannel jobs pass speaker_channel. GET /jobs/{id}/captions.

job_id.description: Rev.ai job id (the `id` from revai_submit_job or revai_list_jobs).

speaker_channel.description: Channel to caption, for jobs submitted with speaker_channels_count.

offset.description: Start position from the previous reply's next_offset (default 0).

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in one reply, 1000-20000 (default 15000).
